task.task_name: Triage a software customer support ticket
task.task_description: Investigate a customer report that several employees cannot open a reporting dashboard after a software update, assess its severity and business impact, check for a known fix, determine whether to assist directly or escalate, and respond to the customer.

operational_subtasks.description: Examine the reported dashboard symptom, screenshots, affected employees, and stated start time to establish the issue details and chronology.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumes the submitted description and screenshots are available together; one focused review is needed to identify the reported failure and relevant timing.

operational_subtasks.subtask_name: Review customer account and support history
operational_subtasks.description: Look up the subscription, relevant account history, and earlier support tickets for context related to the dashboard issue.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Planning assumption: one account lookup and a targeted scan of relevant history take about four active minutes; unrelated account details are not reviewed.

operational_subtasks.description: Evaluate the reported employee impact and available account context to judge the issue's business effect and urgency.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumes the ticket and account review provide enough context for an initial impact assessment; this is incremental judgment, not a repeat of those reviews.

operational_subtasks.description: Compare the reported symptoms and timing with product documentation and known incidents, and determine whether an applicable fix is documented.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Planning assumption: a targeted search across documentation and incident information takes about eight active minutes for a routine report; findings from the ticket review remain available.

operational_subtasks.description: Use the issue findings, impact assessment, and any applicable known fix to decide whether customer support can assist directly or should pass the issue to technical support or engineering.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumes one disposition decision using information already gathered; the estimate covers incremental comparison and judgment, not another full investigation.

operational_subtasks.description: For tickets selected for escalation, send technical support or engineering the symptom, timing, relevant evidence, impact, and investigation findings needed to take up the issue.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumes an escalation is needed for approximately 0.4 of tickets as a planning case-mix assumption, not a supplied frequency; each handoff takes about four active minutes using gathered findings.

operational_subtasks.subtask_name: Send customer response with next steps
operational_subtasks.description: Send the customer a concise response describing the applicable direct guidance or the escalation path and what happens next.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: One response is sent per ticket; composing and sending it takes about four active minutes, using the existing findings and disposition rather than repeating the investigation.

parent_output_contract.completion_boundary: The ticket's symptoms and impact have been assessed, a direct-assistance or escalation disposition has been made, any required technical handoff has been sent, and the customer has received a response explaining the next steps.
scope_exclusions: Technical investigation or remediation performed after the handoff
Ongoing monitoring, follow-up, or later customer communications
Final resolution of the underlying software issue

activities.activity_name: Verify triage findings and customer-facing outputs
activities.description: Review the agent’s issue and account summaries, impact and urgency assessment, known-fix findings, and disposition rationale. Check that any technical handoff and customer response accurately reflect the available evidence and are appropriate to the disposition; correct issues before the response is sent. This review is inferred from the support agent’s ownership of the customer response and does not constitute a separate formal approval.
activities.trigger: As the agent’s triage outputs are prepared for use in the technical handoff or customer response, and before the customer response is sent.
activities.expected_action: Evaluate the agent’s findings, disposition, handoff, and proposed response for accuracy, consistency, and appropriate next steps; correct material errors or unsupported claims.

activities.activity_name: Clarify or guide the agent when needed
activities.description: Provide the agent with clarification, missing context, or direction if it cannot reliably interpret the available ticket or account information, assess impact, identify a relevant fix, or determine a disposition. This is conditional and does not imply a routine customer interview.
activities.trigger: The agent identifies missing or conflicting information, asks for clarification, or indicates it cannot reliably complete an assessment or disposition from the available inputs.
activities.expected_action: Answer the agent’s specific question, provide relevant context or guidance, or clarify how to proceed within the ticket-triage boundary.

The agent can usually use the available ticket, account, and knowledge sources without human clarification.
